senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (खटति)
To desire, to wish, to seek or inquire.

m. (-टः)
1 Grass.
2 Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor.
3 A blind well.
4 An axe, a hatchet.
5 A closed or doubled fist, as for striking.
6 A plough.
7 A fragrant kind of grass: see कत्तृण.
E.
खट to seek, to wish, affix अच्.

r. 10th cl. (खट्टयति)
To cover, to screen.

f. (-ट्टा)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
E.
खट्ट to screen, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mf. (-टः-टा)
1 A bier, a cot or bedstead on which dead bodies are conveyed to the pile.
E.
खट to screen, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A go-between, a man whose business it is to negociate marriages: see घटक.
2 The doubled fist of wrestlers or boxers.
E.
खट to seek, to wish, affix वुन्.

m. (-खः)
A man in the attitude of shooting.

m. (-कः)
1 An eater.
2 A glass vessel.
3 A jackal.
4 An animal.
5 A crow.

m. (-कः)
The fist, the hand closed.
f. (-का)
1 Chalk.
2 The external opening of the ear.
3 A fragrant grass: (Andropogon muricatus.)
E.
खट to seek or wish, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A hunter, a fowler, one who lives by killing and selling game.
f. (-का)
1 A small bedstead, a cot.
2 A bier or bed on which the corpse is carried.
E.
खट्ट to screen, इकन् aff.

f. (-का)
A bier: see खाट; also खाटी.

f. (-नी)
Chalk.
E.
खट to seek, इनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also कठिनी.

f. (-टी)
Chalk.
E.
खट to seek, अच् and ङीष् affs.

m. (-ट्टिः)
A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried to the pile; also खट्टी.
E.
खट्ट to screen, affix कि.

f. (-टिः)
1 Caprice, whim.
2 A scar.
3 A bier.
E.
खट to screen, &c. इञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dwarfish, short of stature.
E.
खट्ट to cover or hide, affix ल्यु.

mf. (-शः-शी)
The civet or zebet cat, (Viverra zibetha.)
E.
खट्टा the grass, and अश who eats; also खट्टास.

m. (-सः)
The civet: see the preceding.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Dwarf, dwarfish.

f. (-ट्वा)
1 A bedstead, a cot, a couch.
2 A hammock, a swing.
E.
खट्ट to hide, Uṇādi affix कन्.

m. (-ङ्गं)
A king of the solar line.
n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Part of a bed.
2 A club or staff with a skull at the top of it, considered as a weapon of ŚIVA, and carried by penitents and Yogis.
3 Wood from a funeral pile.
E.
खट्वा a cot, and अङ्क body or form.

m. (-भृत्)
A name of ŚIVA. खट्वाङ्ग one of his weapons, भृत् who maintains.

m. (-ङ्गी)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
खट्वाङ्ग, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous.
2 Erring, going wrong.
3 Stupid, silly.
4 Laid or lying on a bed.
E.
खट्वा a bed, and आरूढ mounted.

f. (-का)
A small bedstead.
E.
खट्वा a bedstead, and कन् affix, fem. form.
